item.text: Перехожу к поведенческой проверке: отдельные процессы, фильтры, статистика, идемпотентность, ошибки и сохранность повреждённой базы.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -euo pipefail
work=$(mktemp -d)
db="$work/taskboard.json"
run() { TASKBOARD_FILE="$db" bun run src/cli.ts "$@"; }
add1=$(run add --title " First task " --tags "Work, work, Urgent" --due 2024-02-29)
add2=$(run add --title "Second" --tags personal --due 2099-01-01)
ADD1="$add1" ADD2="$add2" bun -e '"'const a=JSON.parse(process.env.ADD1),b=JSON.parse(process.env.ADD2); if(a.id"'!==1||a.title!=="First task"||a.status!=="open"||JSON.stringify(a.tags)!==JSON.stringify(["work","urgent"])||a.due!=="2024-02-29"||b.id!==2) throw Error("add failed")'"'
listed="'$(run list --status open --tag WORK --overdue 2025-01-01)
LISTED="$listed" bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.env.LISTED); if(x.length"'!==1||x[0].id!==1) throw Error("list filters failed")'"'
done1="'$(run done 1)
done2=$(run done 1)
DONE1="$done1" DONE2="$done2" bun -e '"'const a=JSON.parse(process.env.DONE1),b=JSON.parse(process.env.DONE2); if(a.status"'!=="done"||!a.completedAt||a.completedAt!==b.completedAt) throw Error("done idempotency failed")'"'
stats="'$(run stats)
STATS="$stats" bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.env.STATS); if(x.total"'!==2||x.open!==1||x.done!==1||x.overdue!==0) throw Error("stats failed")'"'
deleted="'$(run delete 1)
add3=$(run add --title Third)
DELETED="$deleted" ADD3="$add3" bun -e '"'const d=JSON.parse(process.env.DELETED),a=JSON.parse(process.env.ADD3); if(d.id"'!==1||a.id!==3) throw Error("delete/stable ids failed")'"'
for args in 'add --title x --due 2023-02-29' 'add --title    ' 'list --wat' 'done 999' 'wat'; do
  set +e
  stdout="'$(TASKBOARD_FILE="$db" bun run src/cli.ts $args 2>"$work/error")
  code=$?
  set -e
  test "$code" -ne 0
  STDOUT="$stdout" bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.env.STDOUT); if(typeof x.error"'!=="string") throw Error("failure stdout is not one JSON error")'"'
  test -s \""'$work/error"
done
before=$(shasum "$db")
printf '"'{bad json' > \""'$work/bad.json"
set +e
badout=$(TASKBOARD_FILE="$work/bad.json" bun run src/cli.ts list 2>"$work/bad-error")
badcode=$?
set -e
test "$badcode" -ne 0
BADOUT="$badout" bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.env.BADOUT); if("'!x.error) throw Error("malformed-db error output failed")'"'
test \""'$(cat "$work/bad.json")" = '"'{bad json'
after="'$(shasum "$db")
test "$before" = "$after"
test ! -e "$db.tmp"
echo '"'behavioral tests passed'
git status --short
git diff --check"

item.text: Поведенческий smoke-тест уже прошёл; прошлый прогон завершился ошибкой только из-за отсутствия Git-репозитория. Сейчас отдельно проверю исходник и дополнительные граничные случаи без зависимости от Git.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -euo pipefail
work=$(mktemp -d)
db="$work/nested/data/tasks.json"
run() { TASKBOARD_FILE="$db" bun run src/cli.ts "$@"; }
empty=$(run list)
EMPTY="$empty" bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.env.EMPTY); if("'!Array.isArray(x)||x.length) throw Error("empty list")'"'
run add --title A --tags ', Foo ,,BAR,foo ,' --due 2000-01-01 >/dev/null
run add --title B --due 2999-12-31 >/dev/null
run add --title C >/dev/null
run done 2 >/dev/null
all="'$(run list)
tagged=$(run list --tag FOO)
over=$(run list --overdue 2000-01-02)
stat=$(run stats)
ALL="$all" TAGGED="$tagged" OVER="$over" STAT="$stat" bun -e '"'const a=JSON.parse(process.env.ALL),t=JSON.parse(process.env.TAGGED),o=JSON.parse(process.env.OVER),s=JSON.parse(process.env.STAT); if(a.map(x=>x.id).join()"'!=`1,2,3`) throw Error("sort"); if(t.length!==1||t[0].tags.join()!=`foo,bar`) throw Error("tags"); if(o.length!==1||o[0].id!==1) throw Error("overdue"); if(s.total!==3||s.open!==2||s.done!==1||s.overdue!==1) throw Error("stats")'"'
for invocation in 'add' 'add --title' 'list --status nope' 'list --tag' 'list extra' 'done' 'done 1 extra' 'done 1.5' 'delete 0' 'stats --x'; do
  set +e
  out="'$(TASKBOARD_FILE="$db" bun run src/cli.ts $invocation 2>"$work/err")
  code=$?
  set -e
  test "$code" -ne 0
  OUT="$out" bun -e '"'const lines=process.env.OUT.trim().split(/\\n/); if(lines.length"'!==1) throw Error("not exactly one line"); const x=JSON.parse(lines[0]); if(typeof x.error!=="string") throw Error("not error JSON")'"'
  test -s \""'$work/err"
done
printf '"'{\"version\":1,\"nextId\":1,\"tasks\":[],\"extra\":true}\\n' > \""'$work/extra.json"
TASKBOARD_FILE="$work/extra.json" bun run src/cli.ts list >/dev/null
find "$work" -type f -name '"'*.tmp-*' | ("'! read)
echo '"'additional edge tests passed'"
